431:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ Facility ～

431:t_1:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「...What do you make of it, AG?」

431:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let me see... This is strictly within the range of conjecture, though...」

431:t_1:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「Don't hold out on me. I've already heard about your misdeeds.」

431:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I always strive to deal with you in complete good faith, $$トライア$$...」

431:t_1:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Spare me the empty flattery and get on with it.」

431:t_1:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「There's no room for petty sentiment between you and me. All I want is results.」

431:t_1:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So AG had summoned Dr. $$トライア$$...」

431:t_1:11.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「AG seems to have known what was here even before we took this base.」

431:t_1:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Pressing AG now is pointless. All we'd get is a string of plausible-sounding excuses anyway.」

431:t_1:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes... I can't believe yesterday's confession was the whole truth, either.」

431:t_1:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As I thought, this system bothers you too...」

431:t_1:17.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Believe it or not, I was the head of the $$ギアス嚮団$$. ...Though it was more of a figurehead.」

431:t_1:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Is that what $n calls a $$テンシ$$...?)

431:t_1:21.en:
$$トライア$$
「...Now then, everyone gathered here.」

431:t_1:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「With Miss $$シビル$$ and $$ＡＧ$$ helping, we've figured out roughly what this facility is for.」

431:t_1:27.en:
$$トライア$$
「I knew it. Coming here really does stir the blood of the sleeping $$プロトデビルン$$.」

431:t_1:29.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's as you surmised, Captain $$ジェフリー$$. This is a system for wringing out $$スピリチア$$... what you might call the power of life.」

431:t_1:31.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you forced a translation of their word for it, I suppose you'd call it a $$霊子吸収システム$$...」

431:t_1:32.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「I see... Is its purpose to use that power to draw out the $$オリジン・ロー$$... $$次元力$$?」

431:t_1:33.en:
$$トライア$$
「Exactly. The $$サイデリアル$$ extract $$次元力$$ along the Earth's terrestrial veins, gather it through the $$レイライン$$s...」

431:t_1:34.en:
$$トライア$$
「And on top of that, I believe they control it with the power of life wrung out of Earthlings.」

431:t_1:35.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I thought controlling $$次元力$$ was done by the $$スフィア$$s, but...」

431:t_1:36.en:
$$トライア$$
「Of course they'll use the $$スフィア$$s too. But I'd say the $$スフィア$$s have a separate use of their own.」

431:t_1:37.en:
$$トライア$$
「When it comes to that, I'd guess they prepared this thing as a way to use $$次元力$$ stably for strategic purposes.」

431:t_1:38.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then that's why the minds of those $$血塗られた眼$$ patients end up in a dead state...」

431:t_1:39.en:
$$トライア$$
「Heart, emotion, consciousness... Losing those is the result of having their power of life wrung out.」

431:t_1:44.en:
$$トライア$$
「Humans whose $$スピリチア$$ was absorbed by the $$プロトデビルン$$ were able to reactivate the $$スピリチア$$ within themselves through $$熱気バサラ$$'s song...」

431:t_1:45.en:
$$トライア$$
「Through a similar process, we could probably go as far as restoring the power of life of the $$血塗られた眼$$ patients.」

431:t_1:47.en:
$$トライア$$
「...No. Those eyes aren't caused only by the loss of the power of life...」

431:t_1:48.en:
$$トライア$$
「They're proof that fear has taken over the heart... A trauma, so to speak, given form.」

431:t_1:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So unless the source of that fear is removed, it won't be a fundamental cure...」

431:t_1:50.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Is that the same reason $n's $$血塗られた眼$$ don't heal completely?」

431:t_1:51.en:
$$トライア$$
「I had $$ＡＧ$$ show me $F's data.」

431:t_1:52.en:
$$トライア$$
「Judging by that kid's reaction and the $$サイデリアル$$'s strategy, we should see $$ラース・バビロン$$ as the real heart of the $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

431:t_1:53.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We should regard this place as a prototype built before the $$蒼の地球$$ invaded Earth.」

431:t_1:54.en:
$$ブライト$$
「And the people abducted from all over are gathered at $$ラース・バビロン$$ and having their power of life absorbed?」

431:t_1:55.en:
$$トライア$$
「The power of life isn't something only humans have, though...」

431:t_1:57.en:
$$トライア$$
「As long as matter exists as matter, a power of existence is at work in it.」

431:t_1:58.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「In other words, it has the power of life...」

431:t_1:59.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Does that mean... even objects have souls!?」

431:t_1:62.en:
$$トライア$$
「...I imagine so. Even though I understand the theory, I haven't grasped it by feel myself.」

431:t_1:64.en:
$$トライア$$
「That can wait. Right now we need to think about stopping the $$サイデリアル$$'s $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

431:t_1:66.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To that end, let's take down $$セントラル・ベース$$ and liberate the $$翠の地球$$ as soon as possible.」

431:t_1:68.en:
$$トライア$$
「...This is the first time we've properly met face to face, $n.」

431:t_1:70.en:
$$トライア$$
「You really do have Dr. $$メグミ$$'s look about you. Is it that hair...?」

431:t_1:72.en:
$$トライア$$
「You can't keep running away, $n.」

431:t_1:74.en:
$$トライア$$
「My interest in super-dimensional physics owes a lot to her influence.」

431:t_1:75.en:
$$トライア$$
「Then again, I was still a child when the doctor passed away.」

431:t_1:76.en:
$$トライア$$
「So once I was able to get things moving, I looked into her death in all sorts of ways.」

431:t_1:78.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you want to forget about Dr. $$メグミ$$, I have no intention of blaming you for it.」

431:t_1:79.en:
$$トライア$$
「But don't keep it in some corner of your heart forever and blame yourself. Give that up.」

431:t_1:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's rare... Him acting like that toward anyone.」
